note: Rebuilt for the capability/activation split, not for a lifecycle change. The previous receipt recorded that a promotion required rebuilding every agent, because the agent embedded the authority document and hashed its raw bytes. It now hashes a CAPABILITY projection that excludes lifecycle, quality tier, benchmark authority, evidence and rejection reason, and it declares capability rather than activation at enrolment. A promotion is a control-plane policy write from here on; this rebuild was needed because the digest DEFINITION changed, which is a capability-level event and the last one of its kind for lifecycle work.
